root_cause.confirmed: Frequent business health observation materialized all unreceipted historical inbox signals, bypassing the bounded ready projection.

slow_observation.limitation: Concurrent observational snapshot, not an isolated performance benchmark or attribution of every historical expiry.

root_cause.separate_transient_safety_stop: PROM settlement awaited cross-symbol funding cash; exact wallet reconciliation passed after late income ingestion. This was not rounding error and no cash guard was bypassed.

implementation.observation_scope: Validated unfinished-task projection of any age, bounded recent received-at index range, and bounded tracked previous lag keys.
implementation.incomplete_observation: UNKNOWN; capped counts labeled LOWER_BOUND; known lag retained and recovery timer not aged through unknown intervals.
implementation.historical_gap: Legacy unkeyed alarms and tracking overflow require both cold lanes to pass two distinct post-baseline sweep completion watermarks; no manual alarm reset.
implementation.trade_authority: Observation only. Does not authorize orders, alter admission gates, mutate receipts or change risk policy.

known_limits: The 1000ms SQL work budget is not a hard wall-clock deadline: connection establishment and startup may consume the existing factory timeout before the helper can enforce its remaining budget.
Health runs in the parent supervisor; extreme database outages may still delay its control loop. The trading child remains a separate process.
Cold maintenance still cyclically audits retained history. Its non-covering request-key index causes heap reads; this release removes the competing full-history health scan, not all maintenance I/O.
An empty hot observation is not proof that every retained undiscovered historical signal has a receipt. Historical coverage remains explicitly delegated to cold maintenance.
A short post-release observation cannot establish multi-day stability or strategy profitability.

exact_candidate_broad_regression.initial_failure: Existing test spy did not forward the new observation_unknown keyword argument.
exact_candidate_broad_regression.resolution: Updated the test adapter to forward keyword arguments while retaining the original clock assertions. No production relaxation.

validation.skipped_cases_in_pure_run: Managed-health PostgreSQL cases were subsequently included in the final isolated database regression.
validation.isolation: Disposable PostgreSQL/Redis/ClickHouse QA environment; external network blocked by V2 test boundary; QA databases removed after completion.
validation.exact_candidate_source_comparison: services, v2_core, s0 and s3 source files matched the candidate used by QA.

deployment.protocol: Exact reviewed manifest, graceful stop proof, empty execution cgroups, management-only fresh account coverage, same-binding resume.

post_release.inventory_note: An existing position was partially reduced by the normal running strategy after resume; this maintenance did not submit an order or force a close.

legacy_alarm_identity_migration.write: Health-diagnostics-only CAS, with immutable history source version/hash and complete bounded window proof.
legacy_alarm_identity_migration.normal_monitor_followup: Removed UNKNOWN on its own; retained the existing 120-second recovery confirmation interval.

followup_throughput.why_work_continued: The first clear observation was not sustained. A bounded later cohort contained 248 S6-actionable inputs, 141 expired receipts including 138 with zero attempts. Later windows varied; these are not whole-day totals.
root_causes: Protection witnesses included 919 episode records, 1933 order records and 862 protection records. Repeated credential-field normalization in recursive canonical serialization dominated CPU work.

Five observed protection inventories took only 312-366ms of venue acquisition, but repeated evidence processing consumed the unchanged five-second reuse fence. Every observed exit stage performed another complete audit.
The first high-volume scheduler could exhaust its allocated slice while later light lanes left part of the existing cycle evaluation budget unused. No second pass reclaimed that remainder.

independent_ingress_delay.interpretation: Producer arrival already consumes part of the original validity window. Neither signal timestamps nor validity are refreshed by this fix. This remains an independent latency contributor.

implementation.credential_field_cache: At most 1024 ordinary string field names of length at most 128 map to booleans. No account values, balances, source timestamps, venue observations, policy decisions or complete validation results are cached.
implementation.canonical_compatibility: All values still recursively validated; serialization bytes and evidence hashes unchanged. Long keys and str subclasses keep the original uncached behavior.
implementation.scheduler_budget_reclaim: First-round TV priority, fairness and rotation retained. At most one reclaim turn per productive budget/batch-limited lane, after all first turns, within the same deadline. Prepared/uncertain dispatch, unexpected failure and drain stop further reclaim.
implementation.expected_candidate_wait_followup: Runtime acceptance found that a legitimate existing-position DEFERRED wait prevented reuse of unused peer budget. The final patch accepts only existing-whitelist candidate waits with matching signal identity, result, reason and candidate-local non-authorizing evidence. Unknown errors, ACK failure, incomplete/mismatched evidence and malformed stages still stop reclamation; retry and order authority are unchanged.
implementation.observation_gap_boundaries: Recent inbox cap and first unknown legacy observation persist coverage gaps, preventing false recovery when unknown identities slide out of the recent window.
implementation.repo_only_optimization_not_deployed: StructuralReentryContext market-only fast path; this wrapper is not present in the current controller runtime. It is not credited with any live throughput improvement.

read_only_real_payload_benchmark.limitations: Same retained evidence, three interleaved encoder trials in a read-only process. Not a full trading-cycle throughput benchmark. Profiling itself adds overhead; cProfile timings are not used as production latency.

final_expected_wait_candidate_regression.scope: Pipeline, budget reclaim, fairness, advisory isolation, capacity decline and managed-health tests against exact v3 runtime-shaped sources.

repository_pipeline_including_quant_regr.scope: Same six-file regression against repository sources, including the two quant cases deliberately absent from the running release.

validation.deselection_reason: Quant-only cases target a source not present in this controller runtime. Its existing source support was deliberately not broadened.
coverage: Scheduler fairness, capacity denial and advisory isolation
Budget reclaim, deadline, drain and prepared-order stops
Bounded queue health, observation gaps, legacy CAS and managed health
validation.test_harness: Production modules match the candidate; two additional repository operations helpers were provided only to the isolated QA harness for coverage-compaction and legacy-migration tests. They were not added to the runtime.
validation.initial_collection_failure: Two QA-only operations helpers were absent from the runtime-shaped test copy. Added them to the isolated test harness; reran the complete selected regression to 555 passed.
validation.independent_code_review: No release-blocking issue found in budget reclaim or bounded key cache; two queue-observation false-recovery boundaries were corrected and included in this regression.

deployment.repository_runtime_difference: Runtime deliberately retains its pre-existing two/four-lane support. The repository already supports additional quant lanes; only the reviewed repair hunks were backported. Final source comparison differs only in this pre-existing quant constructor and lane-name wiring.

final_runtime_acceptance.required_services: Controller, market hub, TradingView ingress, dashboard, PostgreSQL, Redis and ClickHouse active/running.
final_runtime_acceptance.signal_lag_alarm_cleared_by: Existing monitor recovery confirmation, not a manual reset or threshold change.
final_runtime_acceptance.acceptance_boundary: Natural queue consumption and existing-position protection verified. No new order was forced; this short final-patch window did not contain a new natural intent, so it is not evidence of a newly completed order round trip.

bounded_throughput_observation_approxima.blocked_reason: STOP_REQUESTED at managed release boundary; the six subsequent sampled cycles completed.
bounded_throughput_observation_approxima.limitations: Latest bounded 501-input selection, not the entire release cohort or all-day totals. Matured means original validity has ended by observation time, not that a trade was opened; all 129 matured receipts in this sample were IGNORED by existing admission rules. Restart-crossing input observations excluded.

cold_maintenance.intermittent_failure: QueryCanceled during bounded adaptive discovery/cold-expiry page work remains observable. All four lanes recovered CURRENT in an intermediate check; the final check had one S8 cold-expiry page retry, while the trading cycle and safety phases completed.
cold_maintenance.self_recovery_evidence: Successful reduced pages of 250/312 entries completed in 103-193ms with commit confirmation and cursor advancement.
cold_maintenance.remaining_design_issue: Historical discovery/expiry cursors and adaptive page caps remain process-local. Restarts begin the cold anti-entropy sweep again and relearn page capacity. Retained history still grows.
cold_maintenance.followup_required: Persist account/consumer/version-bound, commit-confirmed sweep cursors and generation proofs without losing late-commit anti-entropy; separately bound historical coverage witness materialization. Requires dedicated regression, not an alarm suppression or timeout increase.

known_limits: Scheduling budgets are cooperative; an individual external or database operation may overrun, after which no further lane starts.
Processed counters count attempts, not necessarily distinct signals across passes.
The exact full historical coverage facts remain preserved. This optimization reduces repeated normalization cost; it does not claim constant-time processing as retained history grows indefinitely.
Short-window recovery cannot demonstrate multi-day reliability or a profitable strategy.
